description: Ranked best-fit tools for a goal, matched on recorded capability information (not categories), with why + caveat. How it works: the goal is decomposed into required capabilities; only tools whose recorded information covers every required capability become candidates — each capability is labeled 'verified' (demonstration, independent confirmation, known pricing, checked within 180 days) or 'claimed' (vendor-stated, not independently confirmed; never presented as verified). An independent review step then ranks the candidates and gives reasons, or honestly abstains. Possible decisions: recommend; need_clarification (exactly one question, when a key fact is missing); no_match (no tool's recorded information covers the goal — closest partial matches are named); no_recommendation (candidates exist but none is a defensible fit); review_unavailable (the review step could not run — stated plainly, never replaced by a weaker ranking). Every answer carries narrow_by hints: pass budget ('free' or a monthly USD cap), platform, required_capabilities or hard_constraints back to shrink the field on the next round. Pass the goal in plain words, or the already-extracted structured task object (task: action, input_type, output_type, required_capabilities / forbidden_capabilities capability ids, hard_constraints tokens, confidence, known_context) — the server validates the task object and rejects invalid tasks with an error; in the top-level required_capabilities / forbidden_capabilities / hard_constraints arrays, unknown ids/tokens are dropped or ignored instead. On a new user's first call, also returns short onboarding questions (project types, platforms, budget, preferences, tools in use) for you to ask, then call set_preferences with tags only.

forbidden_capabilities.description: Capability ids the task must not need, e.g. ['text-to-video']. Unknown ids are ignored (they match nothing). Honoured by the capability matcher.

hard_constraints.description: Hard-constraint tokens, e.g. 'offline', 'windows-only', 'no-cloud-upload', 'budget-zero-no-card'. Unknown tokens are ignored. Honoured by the capability matcher.

required_capabilities.description: Capability ids the task must have, e.g. ['video-editing','auto-captions']. Unknown ids are dropped. Honoured by the capability matcher.

task.description: Structured task (optional). The server validates it and rejects invalid tasks with an error. Honoured by the capability matcher.
